name: list_accounts
title: List and search accounts
description: List and search accounts. Matches `q` against name and ID. Newest first.

name: count_accounts
title: Count accounts
description: Count accounts.

name: list_accounts_with_incentive
title: List accounts with an incentive
description: List accounts with an incentive.

incentive.description: Only this incentive. Omit for any.

name: create_account
title: Create an account
description: Create an account. Call this when someone signs up. Treat 409 as success so retries are safe. An unknown `incentive` is silently dropped rather than rejected.

id.description: Your own ID for this customer (user or workspace). Stored as sent.

name: get_account
title: Get an account
description: Get an account.

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

name: update_account
title: Update an account
description: Update an account. Shallow merge. Change `plan` from your billing webhooks; set `incentive` to apply an offer. Takes effect on the next `/plan` read.

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

plan.description: Move the account to this plan.

incentive.description: Apply an incentive, or `null` to remove it.

name: delete_account
title: Delete an account
description: Delete an account. Also deletes its usage counters. Usage events stay in analytics.

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

name: remove_account_incentive
title: Remove an account's incentive
description: Remove an account's incentive.

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

name: get_account_access
title: Get an account's resolved access
description: Get an account's resolved access. The main read path. Gate features on `can`: `usage < max`, or always `true` when `max` is `null` (unlimited, and every boolean entitlement). `left` is `null` when unlimited. Entitlements that aren't listed aren't granted. Incentive overrides are already applied, and private meta keys are stripped.

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

name: get_account_access_private
title: Get resolved access including private meta
description: Get resolved access including private meta. Same as `/plan`, plus private meta keys and `privateMetaKeys`. For your server: the public key gets `401`.

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

name: get_account_usage
title: Get all usage counts for an account
description: Get all usage counts for an account. Counts for the entitlements on the account's plan. Entitlements granted only by an incentive aren't included; read `/plan` for those.

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

name: get_usage_count
title: Get one usage count
description: Get one usage count.

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

name: increment_usage
title: Add 1 to a usage count
description: Add 1 to a usage count.

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

name: decrement_usage
title: Subtract 1 from a usage count
description: Subtract 1 from a usage count. Counts can go below zero. The public key can't lower a count.

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

name: add_usage_amount
title: Add an amount to a usage count
description: Add an amount to a usage count. Adds `amount` to the count (it doesn't set it). Negative amounts subtract: post the negative of the current count to reset a quota. The public key can only send a positive amount (or zero).

namespaceId.description: The account ID you chose when creating it (e.g. your user or workspace ID).

amount.description: Amount to add. May be negative.

name: list_plans
title: List plans
description: List plans.

name: create_plan
title: Create a plan
description: Create a plan. Starts with no entitlements, add-ons or meta. The ID is slugified (lowercase `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`).

pricingCard.description: `{ title, description, benefits: [{ id, title }], featured, type: "subscription" | "one_time", monthlyPrice?, yearlyPrice?, price?, currency }`.

name: get_plan
title: Get a plan
description: Get a plan.

name: update_plan
title: Update a plan
description: Update a plan. Shallow merge: top-level fields you send replace the stored ones. `id` and `app_id` are ignored.

pricingCard.description: `{ title, description, benefits: [{ id, title }], featured, type: "subscription" | "one_time", monthlyPrice?, yearlyPrice?, price?, currency }`.

name: delete_plan
title: Delete a plan
description: Delete a plan. Accounts on this plan keep its ID, and their `/plan` calls return 404 until you move them to another plan.

name: merge_plan_meta
title: Merge plan metadata
description: Merge plan metadata. Shallow-merges the body into `meta`. Setting a key to `null` stores `null`. Takes the keys to merge under `meta` instead of as the raw body.

name: list_plan_accounts
title: List accounts on a plan
description: List accounts on a plan.

name: attach_plan_entitlement
title: Attach an entitlement to a plan
description: Attach an entitlement to a plan. `max` is stored for usage entitlements only; `null` or omitted means unlimited.

name: set_plan_entitlement_limit
title: Change an entitlement's limit on a plan
description: Change an entitlement's limit on a plan.

name: detach_plan_entitlement
title: Detach an entitlement from a plan
description: Detach an entitlement from a plan.

name: attach_plan_addon
title: Attach an add-on to a plan
description: Attach an add-on to a plan.

name: detach_plan_addon
title: Detach an add-on from a plan
description: Detach an add-on from a plan.

name: list_pricing_cards
title: List pricing cards
description: List pricing cards. One card per plan that has a pricing card, flattened with `plan_id` and `isFree`.

name: get_pricing_card
title: Get one plan's pricing card
description: Get one plan's pricing card.

name: list_entitlements
title: List entitlements
description: List entitlements.

name: create_entitlement
title: Create an entitlement
description: Create an entitlement. The ID is slugified (lowercase `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`).

type.description: `usage` is counted against a max; `boolean` is a feature flag.

name: get_entitlement
title: Get an entitlement
description: Get an entitlement.

name: update_entitlement
title: Update an entitlement
description: Update an entitlement. Shallow merge. `type` is validated when sent.

type.description: Changing it leaves existing limits on plans untouched.

name: delete_entitlement
title: Delete an entitlement
description: Delete an entitlement. Doesn't detach it from plans or incentives. Remove those references first, or `/plan` shows the raw ID.

name: list_addons
title: List add-ons
description: List add-ons.

name: create_addon
title: Create an add-on
description: Create an add-on. The ID is slugified (lowercase `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`).

name: get_addon
title: Get an add-on
description: Get an add-on.

name: update_addon
title: Update an add-on
description: Update an add-on. Shallow merge.

name: delete_addon
title: Delete an add-on
description: Delete an add-on. Doesn't detach it from plans or incentives. Remove those references first.

name: list_incentives
title: List incentives
description: List incentives.

name: create_incentive
title: Create an incentive
description: Create an incentive. The ID is slugified. Apply it to an account with `PATCH …/namespaces/:id { incentive }`. Inline `entitlements` and `addons` aren't validated here. Prefer the attach routes below.

name: get_incentive
title: Get an incentive
description: Get an incentive.

name: update_incentive
title: Update an incentive
description: Update an incentive. Shallow merge.

name: delete_incentive
title: Delete an incentive
description: Delete an incentive. Accounts that have it keep the dangling ID. Remove it from them first.

name: attach_incentive_entitlement
title: Attach an entitlement to an incentive
description: Attach an entitlement to an incentive. An incentive's `max` overrides the plan's for the same entitlement; entitlements the plan lacks are added.

name: set_incentive_entitlement_limit
title: Change an entitlement's limit on an incentive
description: Change an entitlement's limit on an incentive.

name: detach_incentive_entitlement
title: Detach an entitlement from an incentive
description: Detach an entitlement from an incentive.

name: attach_incentive_addon
title: Attach an add-on to an incentive
description: Attach an add-on to an incentive.

name: detach_incentive_addon
title: Detach an add-on from an incentive
description: Detach an add-on from an incentive.

description: Usage summary by entitlement.

name: top_accounts_by_usage
title: Top accounts by usage
description: Top accounts by usage.

name: get_usage_timeseries
title: Usage over time
description: Usage over time. Daily buckets up to 60 days, weekly beyond.

name: list_usage_events
title: Recent usage events
description: Recent usage events.

name: list_webhooks
title: List webhook endpoints
description: List webhook endpoints. Signing secrets are redacted over MCP; copy them from the webhook's page.

name: create_webhook
title: Create a webhook endpoint
description: Create a webhook endpoint. Also the subscribe call for Zapier REST hooks: pass Zapier's `targetUrl` as `url`, one event and `source: "zapier"`, and store the returned `id` to unsubscribe. The signing secret is redacted over MCP; copy it from the webhook's page.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to POST events to.

events.description: Event types, or `["*"]` for all of them (including future ones).

name: get_webhook
title: Get a webhook endpoint
description: Get a webhook endpoint. The signing secret is redacted over MCP; copy it from the webhook's page.

name: update_webhook
title: Update a webhook endpoint
description: Update a webhook endpoint. Change the URL, events or description, or pause it with `enabled: false`. Re-enabling clears `disabled_reason`. The signing secret is redacted over MCP.

name: delete_webhook
title: Delete a webhook endpoint
description: Delete a webhook endpoint. Stops deliveries and deletes the endpoint's delivery log. The unsubscribe call for Zapier REST hooks.

name: send_test_event
title: Send a test event
description: Send a test event. Sends a sample payload (marked `"test": true`) right away and returns the finished delivery. Works on paused endpoints too.

type.description: Event type to sample. Defaults to the endpoint's first event.

name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: List deliveries
description: List deliveries.

name: retry_webhook_delivery
title: Retry a delivery
description: Retry a delivery. Attempts the delivery once more, right away.

deliveryId.description: Delivery ID (`whd_…`) from the endpoint's delivery log.

name: list_events
title: List recent events
description: List recent events. Every event recorded for the app in the last 30 days, in the same shape that's delivered. Use it as Zapier's `performList` sample.

name: get_app
title: Get the app
description: Get the app. `api_key` and `public_key` are redacted over MCP.

name: update_app
title: Update the app
description: Update the app. Shallow merge. `id`, `api_key`, `public_key` and `created_at` are ignored; use the regenerate routes for keys. Only `name` can change. Keys can't be rotated over MCP.
